en:
That will lead us right to a window on
the third story where we slip right through.

Assuming all goes well, we should be able
to get inside without any triads noticing.

How d'we know that Ed guy's
even there right now?
He usually is.

If he's not, we'll just hang out a while.
Hiding inside's the easy part.

This is the perfect plan, if we can
manage t'pull it off.

Maybe there were some other options,
but I don't mind as long as I can talk to Ed.
Should we get going, Akiyama?

Oh, I almost forgot.
I should give you this.

The Tojo Clan's fourth chairman raiding the
Saio Triad HQ would be a hell of a problem.

Give me some peace of mind.
Pretty good, yeah?

I didn't think I'd end up wearing
another one of these things.
Our old man had it figured out, huh?

For now, Kiryu-san and I will
head up to the roof.

Nagumo-san and Yuta-kun will wait
down here until we're up there.

We'd really stand out if
all four of us went in together.

Once we're on the roof, we'll lower a rope
down. You two can use that to climb up.
No prob!
Well, let's do this.
Try to keep it down.
[Have you checked the shipments?]
[Yes. They're all looking good.]

[Sounds like our work is done, then.
Nice job.]
[Looking forward to some time off.]

[That reminds me,
think you'll be free tonight?]

[I don't have any plans, but I'm not
interested in another cabaret club.]
[C'mon. It'll be fun, I promise.]

[Fine, I'll go if you insist. Just don't
go missing again when it's time to pay.]
[I told you, that was an accident.]
[Accident, my ass. Whatever.]
[It really was!]
Hold on.
We're in the clear.
Huh? Who that!?
Am I imagining things?
Why you here!?
Shoot, they already found us.
He's finished.
Come on. We need to hurry.
Hold on, Kiryu-san!
Just gimme a break already.
What you doing here!?
Intruders!
This is turning into a real problem.

[Apparently there are intruders
in here somewhere.]
[They're probably trying to hide.]
[Let's find them!]
[Where are you hiding!?]
[I know you're here somewhere!]
[Dammit, where are you!?]
Kiryu-san! Don't let them find you!
Hm!?
Figures!
Damn, this is starting to suck.
Kiryu-san! Go for it, now!
Get out the window!
What this!?
What going on here!?

Man, thought this was going
south for a second there.

All right, let's get the
other two up here.
Here goes!
Come on.
That's everyone.
Come on, it's just this way.
It's awfully quiet.
Huh? Nobody home?
It's probably some kind of trap.
I was kind of hoping you were wrong.
Jus' makes it more interestin'!

Oh hell yeah!
Yer up 'gainst me now, y'bastard!
Yuta! Get that one!
The rest of these chumps are ours!
Ed's probably on the second floor.
You should head down, Kiryu-san.

About a man named Tatsukawa.
He was working as a Saio informant.
You guys killed him, didn't you?

"Us" is not quite right.
It is more accurate to say... I killed him.
Why did you do it?

That's what you came to discuss?
Why the sudden interest in him?
I asked you first.

You have no right to question me
about that rat Tatsukawa.
He betrayed the Saio Triad.

Tatsukawa knew that death is the
price you pay for such treachery.

Kiryu-san, are you familiar with
the term <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind>?
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Heihaizi</font_kind>?

It is used to refer to children born
in China outside of the one-child policy.

These children live in the shadows.
They have no official records, no place in society.

As such, they live in squalor,
and the government turns a blind eye.

Some estimates claim they number
in the hundreds of millions.

This Tatsukawa you want answers about
was one such <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind>.
So he was actually Chinese?

The Saio smuggles countless <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> into
Japan and gives them new lives here.

In hopes of someday repaying this generosity,
Tatsukawa joined the Yomei Alliance.

But somewhere along the way, he forgot what
he owed and turned his back on us.

He knew the punishment
he would face in doing so.
In other words, he deserved it.
How exactly did Tatsukawa betray you?

Good question, but I have no obligation
to share that with you.

If you're so interested in knowing, you'll
have to ask Tatsukawa yourself in hell.

I will gladly show you the way there,
Kazuma Kiryu!
I'm not done yet!
It's about time for another righteous whoopin'!
Y'didn't forget us, did ya!?
We can help, Kiryu-aniki!
I've been itching for a workout like this.

I don't understand.
What are you doing here?

A Yomei Alliance officer is
cooperating with the triads?

I thought you guys were signing a pact
with the Tojo Clan in Hiroshima.

Even then, the Tojo Clan is at war with the
triads. They should be your enemies.

I don't care what happens to the Yomei now.
They'll be gone soon enough.

Listen, Kiryu-san. My only allegiance lies to
the triads. I've been a Saio man all along.
What the hell?

If that's true, you're no different
than Tatsukawa.

Tatsukawa was actually Chinese,
born a <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> on the mainland.

He'd been pretending to be
Japanese since he was a kid.
Right. We have that much in common.

However, I'd never betray the Saio Triad
like that traitor Tatsukawa.

Just who the hell are you guys?
What were you doing in Hiroshima!?
Are you really in a position to ask questions?

If anything, I should be questioning you.
Why did you sneak into Little Asia like this?

If you don't want me to kill every last one
of you here, you'd better start talking.

I wanted to know why
your organization killed Tatsukawa.
Tatsukawa... What's he to you?

Before he came to Kamurocho, he had a son,
Haruto, with a girl named Haruka Sawamura.
Haruka is like a daughter to me.
You're Haruka Sawamura's guardian?

I see now. That means the baby you were
toting around Onomichi was actually hers!

Masuzoe! Pull the trigger already!
Stop wasting our time here!

I suggest you calm down, Ed-san.
The boss is here.

Hard t'believe they actually
let us outta there alive.

Seriously. Why d'ya reckon those
Chinese guys didn't jus' kill us there?

No idea. You think that Masuzoe guy
might not be so bad after all?
Nah, fat chance.

He's a piece o' work. Y'ain't got no
idea how much he's put me through.

I never figured on him bein' Chinese, though.
He's one o' them <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind>, right?

First Tatsukawa, n' now Masuzoe.
I jus' don't get it.
What does <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> mean anyway?

It's what they call a child who was born
outside of China's one-child policy.
At least, that's what Ed said.
Oh, I've heard of that.

Under the one-child policy, parents face
heavy fines if they have more than one kid.

But out in the rural parts of China,
there aren't enough hands to tend the farms.

Families'll have a second
or even a third kid to help out.

They never submit any documentation,
though. That's how they avoid the fine.

But since the kids are unregistered, they
can't get education, welfare, or medicine.

Yer pretty damn smart.
Not so surprisin' fer a Tokyo guy.

It seems like the Saio have been smuggling
these <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> into Japan for a while now.

They probably forged all their registration,
effectively making them Japanese citizens.

I guess you could call it some kind
of "human laundering" scheme.

And down in Hiroshima,
is this laundering thing common?
Today's the first I've heard of it.

But at the very least, Tatsukawa and Masuzoe
worked their way up the Yomei Alliance ranks.

I wonder if they were sent t'spy
on us by the triads.

Do the Saio Triad and the Yomei Alliance
have some kind of history together?

If they do, I ain't ever heard o' it.
But we're the bottom rung o' the Yomei ladder.

I thought we were coming here for Tatsukawa,
but we've ended up in something much bigger.

Kiryu-san. Are you really gonna go
meet up with Lo tomorrow?
Yeah. I need answers about Tatsukawa.

If we don't find out why the triads felt
it necessary to kill him in cold blood...

...We'll never know for sure if Haruka's
accident was really just an accident.

And if they truly did mean to attack Haruka,
it's possible the same thing will happen again.
You're right. I guess this is the only way.
Y'sure yer gonna be okay on yer own, Aniki?
They already had a chance to kill me.

If they didn't do it then, I don't expect
them to try again tomorrow.

I'm not entirely sure what Lo's planning,
but I've got no reason to refuse him.
I jus' wish we could go with ya.

After Tatsukawa n' Masuzoe, who knows what
else the triads're plannin' fer Hiroshima.
Oh, I almost forgot.

Do you remember when Lo was
talking to Masuzoe in Chinese?

Thanks to the lessons I got from Tatsukawa,
I could more or less tell what he was saying.
That's too bad.

After all that, we still don't know
why exactly Tatsukawa was killed.

You risked your necks busting into
Little Asia, and still came up empty.

Well, we know that Tatsukawa betraying
the triads had something to do with it.

It's also possible Haruka's accident
was related to that betrayal.
And the Saio Triad?

Would they really try to kill Haruka and
her year-old son just to send a message?

I wouldn't put it past them. Either way,
we need to keep Haruto out of Kamurocho.

Date-san, it was a good call moving
Haruka to the police hospital, too.

That aside, there's still a lot that's
unclear about Tatsukawa's situation.

We need answers.
That's why I'm going to meet Lo tonight.

But with Tatsukawa and Masuzoe, we know
the triads have already infiltrated Hiroshima.
Why exactly would they do that?
Even you're stumped, Date-san?
I'm speechless about all this.

It's hard to believe there were really
triads livin' among us this whole time.

I mean, Tatsukawa n' I have been
friends since we were kids.
I dunno who to trust anymore...

And what could that secret of Onomichi
that Lo mentioned be?

Who knows. All I care about is why
the Saio decided to kill Tatsukawa.

If it doesn't involve Haruka, they can
keep their secrets to themselves.
You... Someya.
This bastard?
Hey, no fighting in here.

Wasn't expectin' t'see yer sorry ass
after comin' all the way up t'Tokyo.
Whaddya want, huh!?

Ha. What do you think of
the ladies in Kamurocho?

They must be night and day from
the country folk, Nagumo-san.

I heard you had a good time
while Kiryu-san was at that host club.
H-How d'ya even know that!?

Every inch of this city belongs
to the Tojo Clan. Did you forget?

If you'd like, I can reveal not only
where you went, but what you did.
Yer a right puckered asshole!
What do you want, Someya?

I half expect your men at every corner,
but I wasn't expecting a personal call.

I have a request, Fourth Chairman.
Nothing too egregious, don't worry.

I'll get to the point, Fourth Chairman.
How would you feel about an alliance?

You met with Lo from the Saio Triad
last night, did you not?

Some of my men said they saw
him going into Little Asia.

Interestingly enough, those same men
said they saw you there as well.
And?
Any chance you'll meet him again?

If indeed you are, I'd like to
accompany you to such a meeting.
What are you planning?

As you're well aware, the Tojo Clan is
ensnared in a brutal war with Lo's triad.

Neither side seems satisfied with the
bloodshed, and there's no end in sight.

I'd hoped to strike a deal with Lo,
but he's been quite secretive.

That is, ever since that
incident occurred.
What incident?
Didn't you hear?

His son, Jimmy Lo,
was murdered in Kamurocho.

Jimmy was a Saio officer in charge of
organizing their forces in Kamurocho.

He stood to inherit the triad, but instead
he wound up full of maggots in some dark alley.
So, did the Tojo Clan kill Lo's son?

I'd rather not answer that in front
of our detective friend here.

Consider this conversation off the record.
Not like we could pursue it without evidence.

In that case, I have no idea
who killed Jimmy Lo.

His father seems quite certain
the Tojo Clan were behind it, though.

Hence, meeting with him is imperative
to ending this war between us.
Please bring me to Lo, Fourth Chairman.

It's only fair that you help the Tojo Clan
every so often, wouldn't you say?

Pipe down. Aniki don't gotta
listen t'ya if he doesn't wanna.

N' besides, Aniki's got some real important
stuff o' his own t'talk to Lo about!
So you <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> going to see him again.
Someya. I need one answer first.
